notes.title: Permanent Price Reduction
notes.content:
It's nearly been a full year since William and Sly launched!
We're incredibly grateful for the support the game has received in that time, currently holding a Very Positive (98%) rating on Steam after 52 reviews. The game is available in 15 languages, largely thanks to the dedicated efforts of fan-translators within the community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly/

Since launch we've run various discounts, and were lucky enough to be included in last August's Wholesome Games Event!

Day-to-day sales tapered off a fair while ago, with new players often finding the game during seasonal sales running for 40-50% off. This is typical for Steam! The indie game economy is largely driven by big sales events. But in the interest of (re)introducing William and Sly to more fans and newcomers alike, we wanted to shift to a base price that would act as a year-round sale!

Starting today, William and Sly will be listed for $15 USD

We'll still be participating in all the usual season sales, but with lower discount percentages early on. Now would be the perfect time to update your Wishlist, and to keep an eye out for those coming sales!

And of course the Classic Collection remains 100% FREE!
If you're totally new to the world of William and Sly, now is the perfect time to get acquainted.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/

Thank you once again for all the love you've shown this series. It means the world!

If you're new here and looking to learn the history, check out the video I made covering the making of the 3 games, including an interview with series creator Lukas Paakh.
-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)

[previewyoutube=53XPNCC6mOw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: William and Sly 🦊 OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
WILLIAM AND SLY RETURN
The hit Flash series, William and Sly, is returning as a 3d platforming adventure!
Explore an expansive wilderness landscape as a fox in search of mushrooms, and untangle the magical machinations of a dark enchantress.

Features
 Open-world exploration
 Collectathon elements
 Minigames and secrets to discover
 No health, or enemies
 Painterly art style
 Tranquil, meditative OST
Collect over 400 mushrooms, uncover mini-games to play around in, and additional skills to enhance your traversal ability.

[previewyoutube=x3HLWPzgZps;full][/previewyoutube]
Soundtrack
Lucas composed 15 original tracks for this game. This soundtrack WILL be for sale shortly, we just need to wait on final package approval from Steam. You'll be able to buy the game and OST together for an additional discount!

Bundles
Are you a big-time platformer fan? Look no further!
This week is also the 2D Platformer Vibes event, being hosted by Retrovibe Games.
You can grab up 4 indie platforming titles together for a heavy discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37938/Ultimate_Platformer_Pack

Or perhaps you're a Flash game fanatic like myself?
Check out this collection of direct sequels to hit games from the golden age of browser gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39200/Flash_Game_Legasequels/

notes.title: First Public Demo - William and Sly
notes.content:
PUBLIC DEMO
William and Sly is a 3d open world platformer, which is a distinctly difficult genre to offer a demo for. But we wanted to be sure players would have an opportunity to test the game for themselves, and get a feel for things ahead of it's planned release (Coming: Spring 2024)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly/

This demo walls off an early portion of the game, so you are still free to roam and explore - but will be spatially limited in a way will be torn back down upon a paid release. You'll be introduced to the game's key characters, exploring a lush plateau area, with the ability to dispel two towers that have emerged in this area.

CLASSIC COLLECTION
Don't forget, the original William and Sly games are on offer entirely for free, as a part of the William and Sly: Classic Collection. A bonus game, The Everloom, was also added in a recent update to that Collection!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/

notes.title: Now Available: The Everloom
notes.content:
William and Sly: Classic Collection
We are thrilled to offer the original 2 William and Sly games entirely for free, directly on Steam! Experience the original games in fullscreen 60 fps for the very first time! Explore the lush environments, soak in the tranquil OST, and seek out all the secrets these games have to offer while working towards that 100% completion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/

The Everloom
With the help of Antony Lavelle (The-EXP), we have added The Everloom as a free update to the Classic Collection. This is a relaxing pixel art adventure. Explore the environment, talk to the people, and swap key items - learning more of the same fantasy dreamworld that William and Sly also occupy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212655/d9a240e3bf63ea2f483c4c3e2dc69348d05efe95.jpg
Release
William and Sly (2024) is targeting a Q1 2024 release date, likely in either late February or early March. So you won't have to wait too much longer! Keep an eye out, as we'll be sharing a public demo soon for the Steam Next Fest, so you can check out the game ahead of that release :)

Series History
Want to know more about the history and legacy of the William and Sly series, dating back to the Golden Age of online Flash games? Check out this video:

[previewyoutube=53XPNCC6mOw;full][/previewyoutube]
Graeme (the Publisher) interviewed Lucas (the Developer) for a retrospective on the series. We talked about Flash development, WarCraft 3, Taoism, motivation, indie games, and everything in between!
